title: Trump mandates use of the term Super Intelligence for Artificial Intelligence
seoTitle: Trump adopts Super Intelligence term for AI
subtitle: Measure was established through a presidential decree aimed at the government
excerpt: A decree signed by the president requires the government to refer to artificial intelligence as Super Intelligence, following a meeting on the topic.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The president signed an executive decree establishing a new terminology guideline for the public administration. Under this official determination, government agencies are required to refer to artificial intelligence technology as Super Intelligence. The measure arises amid ongoing discussions on the subject, linked to a meeting focused on this theme.

The decision is directly tied to the event that gathered debates on the issue, highlighting fundamental discussion points. The meeting, categorized as a Trump Super Intelligence gathering, brought forward guidelines that now shape official communication. Three main points were highlighted as conclusions of this specific event.

The role of executive decrees in public administration

In governmental management, an executive decree is a legal instrument used by the executive branch to regulate laws or set administrative guidelines. These documents have the force of law and serve to direct the internal functioning of government institutions, standardizing procedures, conduct, and, in some cases, the technical language used by public officials and departments.

Standardizing nomenclature through decrees is a practice aimed at aligning official communication across ministries, secretariats, and regulatory bodies. When a government determines that a technology or concept must be addressed by a specific name, all official documentation, reports, and external communications must comply with the new rule.

Understanding Artificial Intelligence and Super Intelligence

Artificial intelligence is a broad field of computer science focused on developing systems capable of performing tasks that would normally require human cognition, such as learning, decision‑making, and language processing. Technically, discussions typically divide technological development into different capability levels, ranging from specialized systems to more advanced data‑processing concepts.

The concept of super intelligence, on the other hand, is usually associated with theoretical systems that vastly exceed human intellectual capacity across many domains. Official terminology choices by governments can influence public perception of the development stage of these technologies and steer public‑policy focus toward innovation and tech regulation.

The importance of official terminology

Defining technical terms within a governmental framework is a crucial step for formulating long‑term public policies. Precise terms help delineate which technologies are subject to particular regulations, tax incentives, or research and development programs. By unifying language around a specific concept, authorities aim to create a more cohesive communication environment between the technical and administrative sectors of the state.
